policy: Source leads and scientific references in this file are acquisition inputs only. They do not populate atlas-specimen-set releaseSlots and do not authorize a model for production. Every final specimen must still pass binary intake, rights, botanical review, photorealism review, semantic mapping, desktop/mobile budgets, and browser QA.

sourceLeads.title: Small cannabis plant in a bonsai pot
sourceLeads.notes: Useful juvenile-scale geometry lead, but must be rejected if it lacks cotyledons/juvenile leaflet complexity or reads as a miniature mature plant. Pot must be removed and roots added.

specimens.blockingNeed: A genuinely juvenile plant with seedling-scale roots; a bonsai-style mature plant cannot substitute.

sourceLeads.title: Hemp, Weed, Cannabis Sativa
sourceLeads.notes: Three editable hemp bush variations; leaves use a particle system and can be adjusted. Strong vegetative base candidate if the authenticated Blender download can be acquired and converted cleanly.

sourceLeads.title: Cannabis Plant in a Terracotta Pot
sourceLeads.notes: Current generic canopy candidate. Must prove vegetative morphology, remove pot, and add exposed roots before this slot can use it.

specimens.blockingNeed: Mature fan leaves, nodes/internodes and branching without mature floral clusters, plus a developed exposed root system.

sourceLeads.title: Cannabis Bloom
sourceLeads.notes: Flower/bud-specific CC0 lead. Must be reviewed as a whole-plant specimen rather than a decorative bud model and must receive an exposed root system.

sourceLeads.title: Green Kush
sourceLeads.notes: Bud-tagged alternate visual lead; do not assume full-plant or accurate floral morphology from the listing title.

scientificReference.notes: Female flowering Cannabis sativa subsp. indica; useful for floral morphology review, not a same-object multi-view reconstruction set.

specimens.blockingNeed: Default Atlas specimen: whole mature flowering plant, realistic inflorescence distribution and full exposed roots.

scientificReference.notes: Use to review whole-plant male architecture, staminate clusters and pollen-sac morphology.

specimens.blockingNeed: No credible reusable male cannabis 3D candidate has been found. Build a distinct male specimen from reviewed reference material; do not relabel a generic/female plant.

sourceLeads.title: Purple Dream
sourceLeads.notes: Distinct cannabis asset lead, but sex phenotype must be demonstrated from the binary/screenshots before it can enter the female candidate pool.

scientificReference.notes: Use for pistillate sex expression, bract/stigma morphology and female inflorescence review.

specimens.blockingNeed: Must remain visually and geometrically distinct from the generic Flowering stage specimen, with clearly demonstrable female reproductive structures.

scientificReference.notes: Punja et al. documents anthers developing within otherwise pistillate inflorescences, including recognizable anther clusters adjacent to stigmas. Use as a morphology constraint; do not present AI deformation as intersex biology.

specimens.blockingNeed: No credible reusable intersex 3D candidate has been found. Build this specimen manually/generatively from reviewed female + anther morphology and require the strictest botanical review.
